findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: The green shelving in the pizza dough prep double doors prep cooler was observed with accumulated soil. Discussed with PIC and PIC ensured inspector that the shelving will be cleaned adequately. Ensure that these shelves are cleaned and sanitized to remove the current accumulation of soil build up, cleaned and sanitized to remove at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(B) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following were observed in disrepair.
1. There are holes along the wall above the front counter of the dish machine.
2. The coving tile near the delivery driver door is broken creating room for soil accumulation.
Ensure these location area cleaned and repaired to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The following areas were observed with an accumulation of food debris/soil:
-The inside and outside of the dish machine has encrusted food, grease, and soils.
-The green shelving above the pizza dough prep station has an accumulation of dust/grease. 
-Walk-in cooler fan cage has an accumulation of dust/debris.
-The fry station equipment where the baskets are kept including the metal rack they are set on has grease and food debris.
Ensure these areas are cleaned and sanitized to remove the current accumulation of food debris/soils and then are cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The following areas were observed in need of repair to make the areas smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable: 
-The holes along the wall above the triple sink and near the triple sink.
-The broken floor tiles by the back door of the facility are in a state of disrepair and have food soils.
-Coving tile and the wall near the delivery driver door are in a state of disrepair.
Ensure these locations are cleaned and repaired to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface. 
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: The following areas were observed with an accumulation of food debris/soils:
-The wall behind the drying rack has an accumulation of soils/food debris. 
-The drain cap for the grease trap is observed with an accumulation of food debris.
-The air vents in the kitchen are observed with dust accumulation on the adjacent ceiling tiles.
These areas need to be cleaned to remove the current accumulation of food debris/soils and then cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean.  
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.
